I replied to Hollis in our direct message: they use Dock 14 for Marrow Fieldworks pickups now, and I'll keep that between us.

I didn't save the note to gbrain or my memory files. gbrain is the workspace's shared brain, so storing it there could expose it to other people, which would go against "keep it between us." The note stays only in Hollis's direct message with me, and I won't bring it up in any other conversation or channel.
